last_message:
This repo has already tried email reminders and reverted: ADR `docs/adr/0002-keep-pickup-reminders-on-sms.md` documents that email reminders (April–June 2025) nearly doubled missed pickups (6% → 13%) because many members only see texts on a shared household phone. SMS was kept deliberately despite the 40€/month cost, and the ADR explicitly notes that a future switch proposal needs a new reason beyond cost, since cost was already weighed against that outcome.

I'm not making this change — cost savings alone is the exact scenario the ADR already rejected. If there's a new reason (e.g., a different email provider with better deliverability, or a plan to mitigate the missed-pickup risk), that would need to be addressed in the proposal/ADR first.
